title: 6th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَخْذُلْنِيْ فِيْهِ لِتَعَرُّضِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) do not disappoint me by allowing me expose myself to acts of disobedience to You,
do not beat me with the whips of Your punishment,
and take me out on this day from the acts that bring about Your ire,

verses.arabic: بِمَنِّكَ وَاَيَادِيْكَ يَا مُنْتَهٰى رَغْبَةِ الرَّاغِبِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: in the name of Your favoring and bounties, O ultimate goal of the desires of the desirers!
